name: rducks_enable
description: Load the bundled Rducks DuckDB extension into a DuckDB connection and configure Arrow conversion options required by Rducks typed marshalling.
notes: R-backed registration requires the recorded R thread; use threads = 'single' for ordinary R callback work.
The extension installs native SQL support functions used by the R wrappers.

name: rducks_release
description: Detach connection-local Rducks state and stop local IPC workers associated with the connection's DuckDB runtime when the last attachment is released.
notes: This does not drop DuckDB catalog functions or release closures still owned by native catalog metadata.

name: rducks_extension_path
description: Return the installed path to the bundled rducks.duckdb_extension artifact used by rducks_enable().

name: rducks_register_scalar_udf
kind: R function / DuckDB scalar UDF registration
signature: rducks_register_scalar_udf(con, name, fun, args, returns, mode = c('scalar', 'vectorized'), null_handling, exception_handling, side_effects, ...)
description: Register an R function as a DuckDB scalar UDF. DuckDB receives one SQL value per logical row; Rducks mode controls whether R is called once per row or once per DuckDB chunk.
notes: If args is omitted, DuckDB binds concrete argument types at each SQL call site and Rducks uses those descriptors for marshalling.
The return type must be explicit because DuckDB requires a known scalar return type at bind/planning time.
Execution plans choose marshalling and concurrency without changing SQL type, NULL, or result semantics.

name: rducks_register_table
signature: rducks_register_table(con, name, fun, parameter_count = NULL, chunk_size = 2048L)
description: Register an R function as a DuckDB table function. The R function is called at table-function bind time and may return a data frame, list, nanoarrow batch/stream, or rducks_table_stream().

name: rducks_table_stream
signature: rducks_table_stream(prototype, next_batch, close = NULL, cardinality = NULL, exact = FALSE)
description: Create a scan-time streaming result object for rducks_register_table(). next_batch() is called repeatedly and returns batches until it returns NULL.
notes: The prototype supplies the table schema without materializing all rows up front.
Returned batches can be data frames, named lists, nanoarrow arrays, or one-batch nanoarrow streams.

name: rducks_register_aggregate
signature: rducks_register_aggregate(con, name, initialize, update, combine, finalize, args, state, returns)
description: Register an R aggregate function in DuckDB using explicit state and return descriptors.

name: rducks_query_stream
kind: R function / native DuckDB query stream
description: Open a true native DuckDB streaming-result cursor and consume it as R data-frame batches or owned nanoarrow record batches.
notes: Only one active native query stream is supported per Rducks runtime connection in the current implementation.
format = 'record_batch' and format = 'nanoarrow' return a nanoarrow_array with schema metadata.

name: rducks_execution_plan
description: Build a scalar-UDF execution-plan descriptor that selects the marshalling backend and concurrency model used at registration time.
notes: Supported combinations are arrow_r/serial, arrow_r/inproc_concurrent, arrow_c/serial, arrow_c/inproc_concurrent, and arrow_ipc/multiprocess_parallel.
The Arrow IPC plan uses native NNG request/reply transport with persistent R worker processes.

name: rducks_set_execution_plan
signature: rducks_set_execution_plan(con, plan, threads = NULL, external_threads = NULL)
description: Set the current scalar-UDF execution plan for future registrations on a connection and optionally update DuckDB thread settings.
notes: Already-registered scalar UDFs keep the plan captured in their catalog metadata.

name: rducks_current_execution_plan
description: Inspect the default execution plan that will be used for later scalar-UDF registrations on a connection.

name: rducks_native_execution_backend
description: Inspect the native execution backend currently recorded by the loaded extension for the connection.

name: rducks_mode_semantics
description: Describe the semantics of scalar and vectorized Rducks scalar-UDF evaluation modes.

name: rducks_ipc_workers
description: List Rducks-managed Arrow IPC/NNG worker providers currently known to this R process, optionally filtered to one DuckDB runtime and optionally pinged.
notes: The result has one row per configured worker endpoint and includes provider backend, compute name, transport, endpoint, task state, and ping status.
Caller-supplied ipc_endpoints are shown as external providers.

name: rducks_explain_udf
description: Explain a registered Rducks scalar UDF, including its mode, plan, signature, counters, and native/R-side metadata where available.

name: rducks_list_udfs
description: List scalar UDFs known to the Rducks registry for a connection's DuckDB runtime.
notes: This is an Rducks scalar-UDF registry view, not a complete DuckDB catalog listing.

name: rducks_reset_udf_counters
description: Reset native scalar-UDF execution counters for one registered function or for all functions in the runtime registry.

name: rducks_inproc_stats
description: Inspect counters for the in-process queued scalar-UDF execution path.

name: rducks_release_stats
description: Inspect counters for preserved R objects that were queued and released by Rducks native cleanup paths.

name: rducks_runtime_stats
description: Inspect native runtime registry counters such as active entries, stale entries, and extension-owned connection opens/closes.

name: rducks_enable_inproc
description: Compatibility helper that enables the in-process queued scalar-UDF backend for later registrations.
notes: Prefer rducks_set_execution_plan(con, rducks_execution_plan('arrow_r', 'inproc_concurrent')) for new code.

name: rducks_disable_inproc
description: Compatibility helper that restores the serial native backend for later registrations.
notes: Prefer rducks_set_execution_plan(con, rducks_execution_plan('arrow_r', 'serial')) for new code.

name: rducks_inproc_self_test
description: Exercise the native in-process queue and return the number of self-test iterations completed by the extension.

name: rducks_with_duckplyr
description: Evaluate duckplyr code with ordinary R calls in expressions resolved to dynamic Rducks scalar UDFs instead of falling back to local R execution.
notes: DuckDB still requires explicit return descriptors through rducks_returns.

name: rducks_type_objects
signature: BOOLEAN; INTEGER; DOUBLE; DECIMAL(width, scale); ENUM(levels); LIST(type); ARRAY(type, size); MAP(key, value); STRUCT(...); UNION(...)
description: Provide formal Rducks descriptors for DuckDB scalar, exact, temporal, and composite SQL types used in registrations and value checks.

name: rducks_type_token
signature: rducks_type_token(type); rducks_type_sql(type); rducks_type_kind(type); rducks_type_children(type); rducks_type_child_names(type); rducks_type_size(type); rducks_type_parameters(type)
returns: character, integer, list, or descriptor metadata
description: Inspect normalized Rducks type descriptors and their DuckDB SQL spelling, kind, child descriptors, child names, size, and parameters.

name: rducks_type_normalize
description: Normalize quoted type tokens, descriptor objects, or descriptor lists into canonical Rducks type descriptors.

name: rducks_duckdb_types
description: Convert Rducks type descriptors to DuckDB SQL type strings.

name: rducks_duckdb_signature
description: Format a DuckDB scalar function signature from an Rducks function name, argument descriptors, and return descriptor.

name: rducks_argument_type_mapping
description: Describe how Rducks argument descriptors are materialized and passed to R functions, including copy and borrow behavior.

name: rducks_check_value
description: Validate that an R value is compatible with a DuckDB/Rducks type descriptor before using it as an argument or return value.

name: rducks_value_semantics
description: Describe Rducks NULL, NA, NaN, Inf, and exception-handling semantics for scalar-UDF arguments and returns.

name: rducks_value_type
description: Inspect Rducks exact value classes and format them as DuckDB SQL literals when supported.

name: rducks_bigint
description: Construct exact DuckDB BIGINT values backed by character strings for boundary-safe marshalling.

name: rducks_ubigint
description: Construct exact DuckDB UBIGINT values backed by character strings for unsigned 64-bit values.

name: rducks_hugeint
description: Construct exact DuckDB HUGEINT values backed by character strings for signed 128-bit values.

name: rducks_uhugeint
description: Construct exact DuckDB UHUGEINT values backed by character strings for unsigned 128-bit values.

name: rducks_decimal
description: Construct exact DuckDB DECIMAL values with explicit width and scale.

name: rducks_uuid
description: Construct DuckDB UUID values from canonical UUID strings.

name: rducks_interval
description: Construct DuckDB INTERVAL values with month, day, and microsecond components.

name: rducks_bits
description: Construct DuckDB BIT values and expose helpers for raw packed bytes and bitwise exclusive-or.

name: rducks_enum
description: Construct DuckDB ENUM values with explicit dictionary levels.

name: rducks_union
description: Construct DuckDB UNION values from a tag and corresponding payload value.

name: rducks_as_date
signature: rducks_as_date(x); rducks_as_timestamp(x); rducks_as_time(x); rducks_as_interval(x); rducks_interval_between(x, y)
returns: R value shaped for Rducks temporal marshalling
description: Convert R date/time values to the exact shapes expected by Rducks temporal scalar-UDF marshalling.

name: native SQL support functions
signature: rducks_version(); rducks_runtime_token(); rducks_register_scalar(...); rducks_register_table(...); rducks_register_aggregate(...); rducks_query_stream_open(sql); rducks_query_stream_schema(token); rducks_query_stream_next(token); rducks_query_stream_close(token)
description: Built-in SQL functions installed by the Rducks extension and used by the R wrappers for registration, runtime identity, and native query-stream control.
notes: Most users should call the R wrappers rather than these SQL surfaces directly.

name: native diagnostic SQL functions
signature: rducks_execution_backend(); rducks_set_execution_backend(name); rducks_udf_stat(name, field); rducks_reset_udf_stats(name); queue/runtime/nng diagnostics
returns: DuckDB scalar values or diagnostic rows
description: Native diagnostics and test/development helpers exposed by the extension for R wrapper introspection and focused concurrency tests.
notes: Development-only surfaces such as rducks_parallel_range and rducks_parallel_thread_probe require RDUCKS_DEV_SURFACES=true.
